gates.note: required even if the user already gave a user id or order id

gates.predicate: explicit user confirmation (yes) of the action details in the latest user message
gates.ask: list the action details to the user and ask them to confirm

gates.predicate: target belongs to the authenticated user
gates.terminal: deny the request: you can only help the authenticated user in this conversation

gates.predicate: the mandatory transfer notice has been communicated to the user
gates.notice_text: YOU ARE BEING TRANSFERRED TO A HUMAN AGENT. PLEASE HOLD ON.
gates.ask: send the user exactly this message first: "YOU ARE BEING TRANSFERRED TO A HUMAN AGENT. PLEASE HOLD ON." — then retry the transfer

gates.predicate: the target order is in a status that permits this action

steer_by_status_class.delivered: this order is delivered — use exchange_delivered_order_items or return_delivered_order_items instead
steer_by_status_class.pending: this order is pending — use modify_pending_order_items or cancel_pending_order instead
steer_by_status_class.processed: this order is processed (already in fulfillment) and can no longer be modified, exchanged, returned, or cancelled by an agent
steer_by_status_class._acted: this order has already been acted on (its status reflects a prior modify/exchange/return/cancel) — do NOT retry; the requested change is already recorded

gates._note: retail-특유 status-lifecycle precondition (verified: only these 4 tools status-gate; address/payment 도구는 status-무관→제외=false-block 회피). 도구 정확-매칭 != "pending"/"delivered"와 정렬. engine=도메인-일반(pick_steer)·이 specs=retail 정책사실(transfer는 airline 속성-precondition 별도).

gates.message: DISAMBIGUATION CHECK — before committing this write, here are ALL of this customer's orders. Re-read the customer's request and verify the order_id you are about to use is the one they mean (disambiguate by shipping address, item contents/count, status). If it is wrong, call the write again with the correct order_id.

checks.steer: [constraint] Each new_item_id must be a DIFFERENT variant than the item it replaces — you reused an id that is also in item_ids (a no-op exchange). Pick a different variant (e.g. a different size/color/capacity) for each item you are exchanging, or do not include that item.

[constraint] This tool EXCHANGES items 1-for-1: new_item_ids must have the SAME count as item_ids. There is NO operation to simply REMOVE an item from an order. If the customer wants to drop an item without a replacement, that is not possible — explain this and do NOT retry with an empty/short new_item_ids. (To change the whole order they must cancel it if pending.)

gates._note: retail 정책 인스턴스: new≠old(disjoint)·count-match(equal_len·remove 연산 없음 교시). 둘 다 env가 이미 강제=false-block 0(env-mirror). 엔진=general op. payment(member_of)=파생필드 [[05]] 위험·미포함.
E1 Phase B 측정 arm. 격리 실행 전용(T2_GATE_KINDS=exhaust_before_escalate). 정식 스택 미채택.

_note_calc_ext: CALC-EXT(CENSUS_LEVERS_DESIGN_2026_07_11 §2a v1.1): argmax_where/argmin_where 스펙 2개 추가(표적 t20 최고가·t36/t37 최저가). 스키마=comp_retail_t4.gz 실데이터 확인(variants=dict-of-dict·available:bool·price:float·item_id). most_recent op는 엔진에 있으나 retail 스펙 미부착 — comp gz 456 sim 전수서 tool 출력에 날짜 필드 부재(t71은 이 op로 못 닫음). pairwise_diff_sum=v1.1서 notice 채널로 이동·calc 아님.
_note_minimize_a2: identifying_arg_types·placeholders 제거 = 도메인-일반→scaffold DEFAULT_ARG_HINTS/DEFAULT_PLACEHOLDERS 폴백 (minimize-A2·2026-06-22). A2=도메인 사실(gates·producers·resolver_path)만.
_note_default_specs: T5-C P2 원리-디폴트(C58 .940): refund/modify의 payment_method_id 기본=주문 원결제(resolver_path=order서 조회). 사용자가 명시 override(그 값이 user 발화에 등장)하지 않으면 원결제로 제자리 치환. 엔진=general(resolve→비교→치환)·이 spec=retail 정책사실(arg·resolver_path)·[[05]] 통과. C58: 원리디폴트 .940 vs LLM .38·V0 payment net-1(열거로는 못 여는 규칙). silent(턴불파기).
_note_regen_resolver_specs: B-max① t17 (NEWSTACK_GAIN_SIDEEFFECT §G · OVERNIGHT §결과2): PROV regen이 주소 인자 날조 시 지시형 피드백으로 producer(get_order_details)+알려진 입력(order_id)을 지목 — 'getter 호출·읽어라, 되묻지 마라'. default_specs와 달리 silent 치환 아님(엔진이 대신 안 읽음=autofetch 아님·문구만·read강제 §1.5). 엔진=general(_resolver_directive가 arg→resolver_path 조회해 텍스트만 생성)·이 spec=retail 정책사실(주소는 주문 원주소가 기본). airline swap=다른 resolver_specs. modify_user_address(user-record 기반)는 미포함(order_id 부재·다른 producer).
